metric: Average percentage of available marks achieved, not full-mark success rate.
aggregation: 100 * sum(disjoint published rounded mean marks) / original question maximum. Only source-bound maximum corrections; no estimates or recalibration.

provenance.decision: Question p16 and original/converted scheme pp10-11 give (a)2,(b)(i)1,(b)(ii)1. Report p10 incorrectly prints 2 for both one-mark subparts; p11 distributions 15.6%/11.3% gaining one support means .16/.11. Use means .72+.16+.11=.99 out of4=24.75%, retaining printed 36/8/5.5 percentages and erroneous maxima. No row relabelling or value substitution.

provenance.decision: Question p17 and scheme p11 give (a)2,(b)2. Report p10 wrongly prints4 for(b), and an unrelated volume description. Its p11 distribution for Q23b has4.8% scoring1 and7.8% scoring2, mean.204, corroborating published mean.20. Use .87+.20=1.07 of4=26.75%. Report descriptors do not define mapping.

provenance.distributionPolicy: Use published mean-mark tables as the primary measured dataset, aggregated against source QP/scheme maxima. All six table totals reconcile within rounded-row precision to the report paper summaries (33.7,30.0,29.0,28.9,35.4,27.2). Preserve contradictory distribution tables as secondary evidence; do not silently replace published means with another internally inconsistent table. In particular 2H p19 disagrees with p18 at most questions, while p18 sums35.38 against35.4 on p7; cause unknown. 1H p17 Q21 omits higher-score rows (total96.8% in the shown cells), whereas p16 mean.44 is retained. 1H p17 Q7b includes an extra2-mark cell for a1-mark part; retain the anomaly. No new cohort or guessed cell values are invented.

sourceDecisions: Question p16 and original/converted scheme pp10-11 give (a)2,(b)(i)1,(b)(ii)1. Report p10 incorrectly prints 2 for both one-mark subparts; p11 distributions 15.6%/11.3% gaining one support means .16/.11. Use means .72+.16+.11=.99 out of4=24.75%, retaining printed 36/8/5.5 percentages and erroneous maxima. No row relabelling or value substitution.
